name: herdr
verification: This file is the single source of the pin. scripts/fetch-herdr-runtime.sh downloads and verifies the asset against it for every app build and e2e run, and desktop/scripts/package.mjs ships that verified binary inside hide.app. linux_x86_64 is the same release's Linux asset, which only the Linux checks lane runs for the schema comparison; its digest is recorded here for the same reason. windows_x86_64 is the same release's Windows zip (herdr.exe and its ConPTY runtime): scripts/fetch-herdr-runtime.ps1 verifies and unpacks it for the Windows lane, which is the only place it runs. contracts/herdr-api.schema.json is the schema this binary reports. Change all of it with scripts/bump-herdr.sh <release-tag>, never by hand.
